# Report catalogue

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from src/pse_opendata/catalog.py; do not edit by hand -->

Checked on 2026-10-26 against the [OpenAPI description](https://api.raporty.pse.pl/api/openapi) of the reports API, the [field map](https://api.raporty.pse.pl/EndpointsMap.pdf), the report pages on raporty.pse.pl and the API itself. A unit that no PSE source confirms is marked *unverified*. Prices: PSE writes `zł/MWh` and `zł/MW-h`; here `PLN/MWh` (energy) and `PLN/MW/h` (capacity, per MW and hour).

**Revision window**: how many days after the end of a month PSE republished data of that month (latest republication seen for September 2025 to October 2026, rounded up). The cache downloads a month again until it was fetched at least this long after the month ended.

### Prices

#### rce-pln

**Market price of electricity (RCE)** (Rynkowa cena energii elektrycznej (RCE)). RCE price used e.g. in prosumer settlement. Hourly RCE before 2024-06-14: legacy PL_CENY_RYN_EN.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 3 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/rce-pln>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `rce_pln` | RCE, described by PSE as the day-ahead wholesale market price of electricity | PLN/MWh |

- Hourly product until delivery day 2025-09-30: the API repeats the hourly value in the four quarter-hours. Quarter-hourly values from 2025-10-01.

#### csdac-pln

**Single Day-ahead Coupling price** (Cena SDAC). Day-ahead market coupling price for Poland. Differs from RCE.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 3 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/csdac-pln>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `csdac_pln` | Price of the single day-ahead coupling (SDAC) for the Polish bidding zone | PLN/MWh |

- Hourly product until delivery day 2025-09-30: the API repeats the hourly value in the four quarter-hours. Quarter-hourly values from 2025-10-01.

### Balancing market

#### crb-rozl

**Energy prices (balancing market settlement)** (Ceny energii). Settlement prices of the balancing market, including the imbalance price CEN.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 120 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/crb-rozl>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `cen_cost` | CEN, imbalance price | PLN/MWh |
| `ckoeb_cost` | CKOEB, marginal price of balancing energy in BPKD/BO | PLN/MWh |
| `ceb_sr_cost` | CEBsr, weighted average price of balancing energy | PLN/MWh |
| `ceb_pp_cost` | CEBpp, price of balancing energy activated outside the European balancing energy platforms | PLN/MWh |
| `ceb_sr_afrrg_cost` | Average price of balancing energy from aFRR up activations on the aFRR platform | PLN/MWh |
| `ceb_sr_afrrd_cost` | Average price of balancing energy from aFRR down activations on the aFRR platform | PLN/MWh |

- aFRR platform prices are empty before business date 2025-07-11.
- Settlement data are republished after corrections (e.g. June 2024 republished on 2025-09-16), so values can change after the first publication.
- EndpointsMap.pdf swaps the labels of ceb_sr_cost and ceb_pp_cost; the report page is followed here.

#### en-rozl

**The amount of unbalanced energy** (Ilość energii niezbilansowania). Volume of imbalance energy of the power system per settlement period.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 240 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/en-rozl>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `en_d` | Imbalance energy delivered (EN) | MWh |
| `en_w` | Imbalance energy withdrawn (EN) | MWh |
| `balance` | Balance of imbalance energy | MWh |

#### eb-rozl

**Activated volume of balancing energy** (Ilość energii bilansującej aktywowanej). Activated balancing energy volumes.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 120 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/eb-rozl>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `eb_d_pp` | Balancing energy delivered, activated outside the European balancing energy platforms (EBpp) | MWh |
| `eb_w_pp` | Balancing energy withdrawn, activated outside the European balancing energy platforms (EBpp) | MWh |
| `eb_afrrg` | Balancing energy from aFRR up activations on the aFRR platform | MWh |
| `eb_afrrd` | Balancing energy from aFRR down activations on the aFRR platform | MWh |

- aFRR platform volumes are empty before business date 2025-07-11.

#### cmbp-tp

**Balancing capacity prices, primary (day-ahead) procurement** (Ceny mocy bilansujących nabytych w trybie podstawowym). Clearing prices of balancing capacity bought in the primary procurement, per reserve product.

- Resolution: 1h; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 3 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/cmbp-tp>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `fcr_g` | FCR up (frequency containment reserve) | PLN/MW/h |
| `fcr_d` | FCR down | PLN/MW/h |
| `afrr_g` | aFRR up (automatic frequency restoration reserve) | PLN/MW/h |
| `afrr_d` | aFRR down | PLN/MW/h |
| `mfrrd_g` | mFRRd up (manual frequency restoration reserve, direct activation) | PLN/MW/h |
| `mfrrd_d` | mFRRd down | PLN/MW/h |
| `rr_g` | RR up (replacement reserve) | PLN/MW/h |
| `rr_d` | RR down | PLN/MW/h |

- Empty value: no capacity procured because the demand for that reserve type was 0 MW; 0: demand was above 0 MW but nothing was procured (comment on the report page).
- rr_d has had no value since the start of the report (checked 2026-10-26).

#### mbu-tu

**Balancing capacity volume, supplementary procurement** (Wielkości mocy bilansujących nabytych w trybie uzupełniającym). Balancing capacity bought in the supplementary procurement.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)

| Field | Description | Unit |

#### popmb-rmb

**Portfolio offers for balancing capacity** (Oferty portfolio na moce bilansujące). Anonymous portfolio offers of the primary balancing capacity procurement; many rows per hour.

- Resolution: 1h; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 3 days
- Several rows per interval, keyed by `reserve_type`, `com`, `pom`, `comrr`; rows can repeat exactly
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/popmb-rmb>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `reserve_type` | Reserve product, e.g. 'aFRRᴳ' (up) or 'aFRRᴰ' (down) | text |
| `pom` | POM, offered volume of balancing capacity | MW (unverified) |
| `com` | COM, unit price of the offered volume | PLN/MW/h |
| `comrr` | COMRR, unit price of the offered volume contracted as RR | PLN/MW/h |

- reserve_type uses the modifier letters U+1D33 (ᴳ, up) and U+1D30 (ᴰ, down), as published.
- About 4,000-9,000 rows per business date; identical offers appear as identical rows.
- The API pages with a keyset cursor over (dtime_utc, pom, com, comrr, reserve_type), which skips rows with empty or repeated values at page boundaries (8 of 8,286 rows lost for 2025-10-02 with 1,000-row pages); this client requests one business date per page.

### Power system

#### his-wlk-cal

**Fundamental data** (Wielkości podstawowe). Actual demand, generation by unit type, wind, PV and cross-border exchange of the Polish system.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 60 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/his-wlk-cal>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `demand` | KSE power demand (identical to kse-load load_actual) | MW |
| `jg` | Generation of scheduling units in the KSE (JGw, JGm, JGz and JGa) | MW |
| `jgw1` | Generation of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `jgw2` | Generation of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `jgm1` | Generation of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `jgm2` | Generation of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `jgz1` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `jgz2` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `jgz3` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=3 | MW |
| `jga` | Generation of aggregator scheduling units (JGa) | MW |
| `jgo` | Consumption of receiving scheduling units (JGo) | MW |
| `jnwrb` | Generation of units not actively participating in the balancing market | MW |
| `jgm` | Total charging power of energy storage scheduling units (JGm) | MW |
| `wi` | Total generation of wind sources, units on and off the balancing market | MW |
| `pv` | Total generation of photovoltaic sources, units on and off the balancing market | MW |
| `swm_p` | Domestic balance of cross-border exchange, parallel (synchronous); + = import | MW |
| `swm_np` | Domestic balance of cross-border exchange, non-parallel (asynchronous); + = import | MW |

- Near real time: future intervals of the current day are returned with empty values.
- The API also returns the last quarter-hour of business date 2024-06-13.
- jgm is never positive in the data (charging is negative); the sign convention is not stated by PSE.

#### kse-load

**Load of Polish Power System** (Zapotrzebowanie mocy KSE). Forecast and actual demand of the national power system.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 60 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/kse-load>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `load_fcst` | Forecasted total load | MW |
| `load_actual` | Actual total load (identical to his-wlk-cal demand) | MW |

- The API also returns the last quarter-hour of business date 2024-06-13.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14

- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/pdgopkd>

| `gen_wi` | Total generation of wind sources (plan) | MW |
| `gen_fv` | Total generation of photovoltaic sources (plan) | MW |
| `gen_jgw_jgm_jgz_jga` | Generation of scheduling units JGw, JGm, JGz and JGa | MW |
| `gen_jgw_zak_1` | Generation of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `gen_jgw_zak_2` | Generation of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `gen_jgm_zak_1` | Generation of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `gen_jgm_zak_2` | Generation of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `gen_jgz_zak_1` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `gen_jgz_zak_2` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `gen_jgz_zak_3` | Generation of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=3 | MW |
| `gen_jga` | Generation of aggregator scheduling units (JGa) | MW |
| `gen_jgo` | Consumption of receiving scheduling units (JGo) | MW |
| `gen_not_activ_part` | Generation of units not actively participating in the balancing market | MW |
| `tot_jgm_char_pow` | Total charging power of energy storage scheduling units (JGm) | MW |
| `dom_balance_exchange_par` | Domestic balance of cross-border exchange, parallel | MW |
| `dom_balance_exchange_non_par` | Domestic balance of cross-border exchange, non-parallel | MW |
| `ogr_mwe` | Planned availability limitations and withdrawals of units (MWE) | MW |
| `rez_over_demand` | Reserve capacity above demand | MW |
| `rez_under` | Reserve capacity below demand | MW |
| `capacity_jgw_jgm_jgz_jga` | Generation capacity of scheduling units JGw, JGm, JGz and JGa | MW |
| `capacity_jgw_zak_1` | Generation capacity of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `capacity_jgw_zak_2` | Generation capacity of generating scheduling units JGw with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `capacity_jgm_zak_1` | Generation capacity of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `capacity_jgm_zak_2` | Generation capacity of energy storage scheduling units JGm with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `capacity_jgz_zak_1` | Generation capacity of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=1 | MW |
| `capacity_jgz_zak_2` | Generation capacity of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=2 | MW |
| `capacity_jgz_zak_3` | Generation capacity of wind and PV scheduling units JGz with ZAK=3 | MW |
| `capacity_jga` | Generation capacity of aggregator scheduling units (JGa) | MW |
| `capacity_jgo` | Consumption capacity of receiving scheduling units (JGo) | MW |

- Wind and PV totals include units on and off the balancing market (comment on the report page).

#### poze-redoze

**Non-market redispatch of RES resources** (Nierynkowe redysponowanie źródeł OZE). Curtailment of wind and PV ordered by the operator outside the market.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-09-24
- Revision window: 90 days
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/poze-redoze>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `pv_red_balance` | PV units, redispatch for balancing of the power system | MW |
| `pv_red_network` | PV units, redispatch for system constraints management | MW |
| `wi_red_balance` | Wind units, redispatch for balancing of the power system | MW |
| `wi_red_network` | Wind units, redispatch for system constraints management | MW |

- Most intervals have empty values (no redispatch).

#### przeplywy-mocy

**Cross-border electricity exchange, technical flows** (Wymiana międzysystemowa, przepływy mocy). Physical flows on the commercial cross-sections, one row per section and interval.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 60 days
- Several rows per interval, keyed by `section_code`
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/przeplywy-mocy>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `section_code` | Cross-section, e.g. 'CZ-PL' | text |
| `value` | Physical power flow on the cross-section; + = import to Poland, - = export | MW |

- Flows exclude local exchange over 110 kV lines (comment on the report page).

#### gen-jw

**Production of generating units** (Generacja mocy jednostek wytwórczych). Generation per unit; units with installed capacity of 100 MW or more and an EIC code.

- Resolution: 15min; rows stamped with the interval end (`dtime_utc`)
- Available from business date 2024-06-14
- Revision window: 60 days
- Several rows per interval, keyed by `resource_code`, `operating_mode`
- PSE page: <https://raporty.pse.pl/report/gen-jw>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `resource_code` | Unit code | text |
| `operating_mode` | Operating mode (Polish label) | text |
| `power_plant` | Power plant | text |
| `operating_mode_eng` | Operating mode (English label) | text |
| `value` | Generation of the unit | MW (unverified) |

## Legacy export (until 2024-06-13)

Hourly reports of the old www.pse.pl data service, available through `https://www.pse.pl/getcsv/-/export/csv/<CODE>/data_od/<YYYYMMDD>/data_do/<YYYYMMDD>`. The export does not state units; units below are inferred and marked unverified.

### PL_WYK_KSE

**Power system operation, fundamental data** (Praca KSE - wielkości podstawowe). Hourly demand, generation of JWCD and nJWCD and exchange balance until 2024-06-13.

- Resolution: 1h, local hours 1-24 (hour 1 = 00:00-01:00)
- Available from 2009-01-01 to 2024-06-13
- PSE archive page: <https://www.pse.pl/dane-systemowe/funkcjonowanie-kse/raporty-dobowe-z-pracy-kse/wielkosci-podstawowe>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `demand` | National power demand | MW (unverified) |
| `jwcd` | Total generation of centrally dispatched units (JWCD) | MW (unverified) |
| `pi` | 'Generacja PI' (column until 2020; not explained in the export) | MW (unverified) |
| `irz` | 'Generacja IRZ' (column until 2020; not explained in the export) | MW (unverified) |
| `njwcd` | Total generation of units not centrally dispatched (nJWCD) | MW (unverified) |
| `swm_p` | Domestic balance of parallel cross-border exchange | MW (unverified) |
| `swm_np` | Domestic balance of non-parallel cross-border exchange | MW (unverified) |

- Columns 'Generacja PI' and 'Generacja IRZ' exist until 2020 and are absent from 2021.
- Demand of the reports API (his-wlk-cal demand, kse-load load_actual) sits about 0.7% below this series around the switch; see pse_opendata.splice_factor.

### PL_GEN_WIATR

**Power system operation, wind and PV generation** (Praca KSE - generacja źródeł wiatrowych i fotowoltaicznych). Hourly wind and PV generation until 2024-06-13.

- Resolution: 1h, local hours 1-24 (hour 1 = 00:00-01:00)
- Available from 2012-05-26 to 2024-06-13
- PSE archive page: <https://www.pse.pl/dane-systemowe/funkcjonowanie-kse/raporty-dobowe-z-pracy-kse/generacja-zrodel-wiatrowych>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `wind` | Generation of wind sources | MW (unverified) |
| `pv` | Generation of photovoltaic sources | MW (unverified) |

- PV is '-' (empty) before 2020-04-10.

### PL_CENY_RYN_EN

**Market price of electricity (RCE), hourly** (Rynkowa cena energii elektrycznej (RCE)). Hourly RCE until 2024-06-13; continued by rce-pln.

- Resolution: 1h, local hours 1-24 (hour 1 = 00:00-01:00)
- Available from 2018-01-01 to 2024-06-13
- PSE archive page: <https://www.pse.pl/dane-systemowe/funkcjonowanie-rb/raporty-dobowe-z-funkcjonowania-rb/podstawowe-wskazniki-cenowe-i-kosztowe/rynkowa-cena-energii-elektrycznej-rce>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `rce` | RCE, market price of electricity | PLN/MWh (unverified) |

- Dates are written YYYYMMDD in this export.

### PL_CENY_ROZL_RB

**Balancing market settlement prices (before the 2024 reform)** (Funkcjonowanie RB - ceny rozliczeniowe). Hourly imbalance settlement prices of the old balancing market until 2024-06-13.

- Resolution: 1h, local hours 1-24 (hour 1 = 00:00-01:00)
- Available from 2009-01-01 to 2024-06-13
- PSE archive page: <https://www.pse.pl/dane-systemowe/funkcjonowanie-rb/raporty-dobowe-z-funkcjonowania-rb/podstawowe-wskazniki-cenowe-i-kosztowe/ceny-rozliczeniowe>

| Field | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `cor` | 'COR' (column until 2020; not explained in the export) | PLN/MWh (unverified) |
| `cro` | CRO, settlement price of imbalance energy | PLN/MWh (unverified) |
| `cros` | CROs, settlement price of imbalance energy for sales | PLN/MWh (unverified) |
| `croz` | CROz, settlement price of imbalance energy for purchases | PLN/MWh (unverified) |

- Dates are written YYYYMMDD in this export.
- Column 'COR' exists until 2020 and is absent from 2021.
- Not the same quantity as CEN (crb-rozl cen_cost) of the reformed market; not stitched automatically.
